lines: A Lord's Brand ascends any piece of equipment to the biome after its boss. Weapons (pickaxes too), shields, armour and summoning staves: base damage (in the item's own damage types), durability, block and armour rise to that biome's items of the same kind and slot (armour and shields: those made at the same station), and always by at least the step between lands - nothing goes down; a summoning staff's minion becomes as strong as that biome's creatures. Their workbench upgrades start over at quality 1 and then cost what that biome's reference item costs. Properties, sockets, sigils and implicits stay. Equipment with nothing to compare - rings, belts, amulets, trinkets, utility items, capes without armour, other tools - gains only item level, unlocking higher property tiers on future rolls; its properties, implicit effects, base stats, durability and quality remain unchanged. One brand per item, and only upward.
new.name: Ascension

lines: A crossbow construct, set up with the siege hammer by any character. It is a skill, not a building: it costs nothing and can stand anywhere, bound only by the ballista limit. It carries a copy of the crossbow in the siege crossbow cell and shoots real bolts from the bolt magazine. When set up it records the crossbow's own damage and a share of its builder's crossbow, projectile, reload and fire-rate bonuses; changing gear later does not change it. Its durability is its crossbow's and runs out by itself in its lifetime, 12 seconds at base; every shot wears it a little more, at zero it falls, and the hammer repairs it. It shoots only while its builder is near; when no creature is in sight it shoots wild birds.

lines: A skill here is an ability: a passive from the tree or a power from a boss sigil that fires by itself when its trigger comes, then waits out its cooldown; cooldown recovery rate shortens that wait. Valheim's own skills (swords, running and the rest) are another thing: their growth goes into tree experience, and governing attributes set weapon damage through the skill multiplier.
